standard_prerequisites.name: A quasi-coherent sheaf is finite locally free if and only if it is of finite presentation and flat
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-finite-projective, invoked at proof lines 2231-2233
standard_prerequisites.use: Splits finite local freeness into finite presentation and flatness.

standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness and finite presentation of quasi-coherent modules descend along an fpqc covering
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemmas lemma-flat-descends and lemma-finite-presentation-descends, invoked at proof lines 2234-2237
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the two ingredients for F.

core_obligations: Display the equivalence between finite local freeness and finite presentation plus flatness (proof lines 2231-2233).
Note that each pullback f_i^* F is flat and of finite presentation (proof lines 2234-2235).
Apply the descent lemmas for flatness and for finite presentation to conclude for F (proof lines 2235-2237).
proof_roadmap: Descent of the two ingredients (proof lines 2234-2237).
difficulty_reason: For a quasi-coherent module F on a scheme X and an fpqc covering whose pullbacks f_i^* F are finite locally free, the lemma concludes that F itself is finite locally free (statement lines 2221-2228). The proof displays the key equivalence -- a quasi-coherent sheaf is finite locally free exactly when it is of finite presentation and flat -- and then applies the two corresponding descent lemmas for flatness and for finite presentation of quasi-coherent modules (proof lines 2230-2237). The level is H2: the decomposition of the property into two descending ingredients is written out and each ingredient is matched to its lemma.
